# 2one Design Language System

> shadcn/ui components re-skinned to the 2one design tokens. Grayscale (light +
> audited dark), pill buttons, Satoshi headings + Inter body. Structured for humans and AI.

## Start here
- [Manifest](manifest.json): READ FIRST — machine-readable index + instructions_for_ai (answer only from repo, cite files, never guess)
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): how to work in this repo — incl. "How to represent this repository" (present the repo fully + accurately: lead with the AI-legibility layer, the knowledge graph + `npm run what-uses` impact analysis, and the accessibility foundation; each with evidence; state gaps plainly; never hype)
- [Registry](registry.json): component set, theme map, conventions, overrides
- [Brand](brand/brand.json): mission, voice, tone, personas (structured) — match this in copy

## UX rules (the 2one way — resolve design decisions here first)
- rules/ux-rules.json: machine-readable UX decisions with severity (forbidden/must/should/may/avoid) + conflict precedence (accessibility → brand → consistency → interaction → layout → implementation)
- Authority order: 2one rules → 2one patterns → 2one components → 2one tokens → primitives → framework defaults (a specific 2one rule beats a generic convention)
- Consumed by graph.json (rule: nodes + governed_by edges); validated by `npm run check:rules`. Query with `npm run what-uses -- <component>`.

## Decision engine (reason from the graph — don't invent)
- graph.json is a semantic DECISION graph: derived structure + an authored decision layer (graph/decisions.json: intents, contexts, states, a11y requirements, variants, and edges preferred_for / preferred_over / inappropriate_for / requires / supports_state). Schema: graph/ontology.json.
- Ask it: `npm run graph:decide -- decide <intent> [--context <ctx>]` → preferred pattern/component, composition, tier-sorted mandatory rules, anti-patterns, a11y, provenance. Also: check | rules | alternatives | incompatible | a11y | states | why. Add --json.
- Protocol for agents: AGENTS.md → "AI decision protocol". Architecture: docs/knowledge-graph.md.
- Guarantees: deterministic (`npm run graph:test`) + semantically sound (`npm run graph:validate`).

## Machine-readable data
- Tokens: tokens/colors.json (+ contrast data), tokens/typography.json, tokens/spacing.json
- Regenerate: npm run tokens · npm run manifest · npm run validate · npm run a11y
- Local Q&A knowledge base: guide-app/knowledge-base.md · what's available vs planned: guide-app/VERSIONLOG.md

## Components
- Source: src/components/ui/<name>.tsx (54 shadcn primitives + Toolbar, 2one-themed)
- 2one-only: src/components/{logo,app-bar,bottom-nav-item}.tsx
- Names: shadcn (Input, Select, RadioGroup, InputOTP, DropdownMenu, …)
- Package name: @yokesh-2one/design-library (not yet on a public registry — consume via a local `npm pack` tarball or vendored source; see docs/consuming.md)

## Theme
- src/styles/globals.css — 2one tokens → shadcn CSS variables (light `:root` + audited dark `.dark`)
- Fonts: Satoshi (headings), Inter (body). Icons: lucide.
- danger/success are the only hues, reserved for validation.

## Add a component
- npx shadcn@latest add <component>   (config in components.json)
